name: RPCS3
description: RPCS3’s inspected updater accepts JSON metadata only when the retrieval URL has the RPCS3 GitHub prefix, then checks the retrieved update’s expected size and SHA-256 before proceeding. No pinned key is visible in this flow; broader transport and release controls remain outside this review.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release-specific behavior and external TLS/framework enforcement were not independently audited.
The inspected code does not establish a cryptographic key pin or the trust guarantees of its downloader/metadata service.
